name: How do I choose the right re-stucco contractor?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right re-stucco contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a re-stucco contractor, look for licensed and insured professionals with a strong portfolio of previous work. Check their experience specifically with re-stucco projects in your area. Request multiple bids and ensure each bid is detailed, outlining materials, labor, and project timeline. Ask for references from past clients and review online testimonials. A reliable contractor will also offer clear communication, provide warranties for their work, and adhere to local building codes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a re-stucco contractor by verifying licenses and insurance, checking their portfolio, requesting detailed bids and references, and ensuring good communication and warranties.
